metadata.question: Did burn scars near San Jose, California on August 26, 2020 expand in comparison to the same region in June?

data.raw_code: The question is about burn scars near San Jose, California, comparing August 26, 2020 to June 2020. This is a change detection problem for burned areas. Key considerations: 1. Location: San Jose, California area 2. Time periods: August 26, 2020 vs June 2020 3. Phenomenon: Burn scars (burned areas) For burn scar detection, I can use: - NBR (Normalized Burn Ratio) = (NIR - SWIR) / (NIR + SWIR) - dNBR (differenced NBR) = pre-fire NBR - post-fire NBR - Higher dNBR values indicate more severe burning Data sources: - Sentinel-2 MSI for high resolution burn mapping - Landsat 8 as backup if Sentinel-2 has no data Approach: 1. Create geometry around San Jose area 2. Get pre-fire image (June 2020) and post-fire image (August 26, 2020) 3. Calculate NBR for both 4. Calculate dNBR = June NBR - August NBR 5. Threshold dNBR to identify burned areas 6. Compare burned area extent Validation: - Check if collections have data - Check if valid pixels exist after masking - Ensure calculations are valid For the answer logic: - If August burned area > June burned area: A (Yes) - Else: B (No) - Handle C1, C2, C3 cases as needed ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const sanJose = ee.Geometry.Point([-121.8863, 37.3382]); const region = sanJose.buffer(20000); // 20km buffer around San Jose // Time periods const juneDate = ['2020-06-01', '2020-06-30']; const augustDate = ['2020-08-20', '2020-08-31']; // Window around Aug 26 // 2. Data Acquisition - Sentinel-2 for burn scar analysis function getS2Collection(dateRange, geometry) { return ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(geometry) .filterDate(dateRange[0], dateRange[1]) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 20)); } function calculateNBR(img) { const nbr = img.normalizedDifference(['B8', 'B12']).rename('NBR'); return img.addBands(nbr); } // Get collections const juneCol = getS2Collection(juneDate, region); const augustCol = getS2Collection(augustDate, region); // Check collection sizes const juneSize = juneCol.size().getInfo(); const augustSize = augustCol.size().getInfo(); console.log(`June 2020 Images: ${juneSize}`); console.log(`August 2020 Images: ${augustSize}`); if (juneSize === 0 || augustSize === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } // Get median composites const juneImg = calculateNBR(juneCol.median()).select('NBR'); const augustImg = calculateNBR(augustCol.median()).select('NBR'); // Calculate dNBR (pre-fire - post-fire) const dnbr = juneImg.subtract(augustImg).rename('dNBR'); // Threshold for burn scars (dNBR > 0.1 indicates burning) const burnThreshold = 0.1; const juneBurned = juneImg.lt(-0.1); // Low NBR indicates burned const augustBurned = augustImg.lt(-0.1); const newBurns = dnbr.gt(burnThreshold); // Areas that became more burned // Count burned pixels const juneCount = juneBurned.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: region, scale: 100, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NBR').getInfo(); const augustCount = augustBurned.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: region, scale: 100, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NBR').getInfo(); const newBurnCount = newBurns.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: region, scale: 100, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('dNBR').getInfo(); console.log(`June burned pixels: ${Math.round(juneCount)}`); console.log(`August burned pixels: ${Math.round(augustCount)}`); console.log(`New burn pixels: ${Math.round(newBurnCount)}`); // Validation checks if (juneCount === null || augustCount === null || newBurnCount === null) { console.log("C3"); return; } if (juneCount === 0 && augustCount === 0) { console.log("C2"); return; } // Determine if burn scars expanded const burnExpanded = newBurnCount > 1000; // Threshold for meaningful expansion if (burnExpanded) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
